title: AI Text Game with LLM Powering the Ideas of Players and Creators
author: GoodLopsided233
selftext:
Wanna share a project we built:

- RPGGO Copilot is an **advanced generative AI engine** **made up of four agents tailored for creating interactive games**. By integrating with multiple AGI models, it is capable of reading and processing real-time text inputs to construct a game story framework with corresponding logic. Moreover, it is **highly customizable** to accommodate varying requirements and detailed inputs. With RPGGO Copilot, you can deliver an ultimate gaming experience to players as game creators and game devs.

- Our users are: **scriptwriters, indie authors, TRPG gamers, college students majoring in computer science and AI, and anime enthusiasts.** 

AI Game Lobby from Creators in UGCs

⛺️ **Try to** **Create:** [**https://creator.rpggo.ai**](https://creator.rpggo.ai/)

  
Sample of games:

- Which One is the Spy (Historical theme, detective text game) [https://rpggo.ai/game/d7a4dd4d-89e6-4862-866c-4f470a14d988#/game?gameId=d7a4dd4d-89e6-4862-866c-4f470a14d988](https://rpggo.ai/game/d7a4dd4d-89e6-4862-866c-4f470a14d988#/game?gameId=d7a4dd4d-89e6-4862-866c-4f470a14d988)
